text: Femi - interview @ Deloitte Thurs 6 Nov 2026 at 10am. v nervous, 2nd round. text him good luck Weds night
Camila veggie, no mushrooms either. her partner Tiago eats anything
Lwazi lives Leeds now, Headingley. works @ the uni library
Ruby - applied for the band 6 job at St James's, closing date 14 Nov. hears back early Dec
bins out tues. dentist mine 12th at half 9
Isaac allergic to sesame - proper allergy, carries epipen. careful w/ hummus at the bbq

called Bethany re: her sister's wedding - moved to 3 May 2027 now, not April (venue double booked). B is maid of honour + v stressed abt the speech, hasn't started it. also her mum's knee op is the wk before so she's juggling that. offered to read a draft. text her Sun evening to see if she's written anything, and send her that speech template thing
Idris got the job!! starts @ Ocado 1 Dec. send congrats + ask how 1st wk goes
Agnieszka - from Kraków, lives Walthamstow w/ husband + 2 kids. teaches piano
Kofi only drinks oat flat whites. hates coffee shop chains lol
Obi's interview yday (the civil service one) - didn't sound confident after. remind me to ask Obi if he's heard back by Fri
Marcus + Meera - housewarming Sat 22 Nov from 7pm. bring wine, Meera's teetotal tho so something nice non-alc too

Divya's mum in hospital since Sun - fell in the garden, hip op Weds morning, 1st on the list at 8. Divya not sleeping, going in every day after work + her brother Siddharth's useless apparently, lives in Manchester and hasn't come down. she sounded wrecked on the phone. check in w/ her Thurs, maybe offer to drive her in at the wknd
Siddharth - wants to leave consulting, looking at product roles. asked if I'd look over his CV. need to do it by this wknd
Arturo - coeliac. strict, not just a preference
Zoe's dog Biscuit had surgery on his paw this morning - all went fine. she's picking him up tomorrow at 4
Farah moved to Bristol in Aug 2026, works remote for a fintech. brother Yusuf still in Croydon w/ their dad
Yuki - panel interview Mon 3pm for the research post @ Kew. third one this yr. remind me to text her Mon lunchtime
Heather - Sunday lunch cancelled, her husband's got covid. rearrange for Jan?
Elif vegan since summer. loves Turkish breakfast tho - fine w/o the sucuk
Abebe lives in Peckham w/ his wife Efua. she's a midwife @ Kings
need to sort car MOT before 30 Nov. garage opens 8am

Victor - rejected by Google after the final round, gutted. been applying since March 2026, this was the closest he's got. he said the feedback was 'not enough system design' which he thinks is rubbish. his girlfriend Demi wants him to take a break over xmas. message him this wk, take him for a pint, don't bring up jobs unless he does
Aoife's bday 19 Dec - mentioned wanting a proper cast iron pan. Le Creuset?? check prices
Oliver - Mrs Bianchi (his old boss) offered him a job back at the agency. deciding by Fri. leaning yes
Demi - doesn't eat pork, doesn't drink. likes Ting + spicy food. note for her bday dinner
Sam's grad scheme assessment centre Tues 25 Nov, all day from 9. ask Sam how it went on the Weds
Tiago - Portuguese, from Porto. works in hospitality, manages a bar in Shoreditch
Femi update - got through to final round!! 2nd interview went well. final is 18 Nov at 2pm
Ibrahim Usman - neighbour no. 14. retired, ex bus driver. wife passed few yrs ago. son Idris visits Sundays
Ruby's brother Marcus engaged!! wedding prob summer 2027. she's thrilled
Camila - job offer from the NHS trust but salary low. negotiating. call her tomorrow evening to talk it thru
meal prep sun, gym 7am mon/weds/fri. sort out pension letter
Kofi + Zoe - anniversary dinner Sat. 5 yrs. their kids staying @ her mum's

Lwazi's PhD viva - 12 Jan 2027 at 10am, external examiner from Edinburgh. he's terrified, keeps saying ch 4 is weak. wants to do a mock viva w/ me + Isaac before xmas, ideally the wk of 15 Dec, evening. must book a date + a room. he's vegetarian so if we do food after, the Indian place
Meera - lactose intolerant. ok w/ hard cheese apparently. her dad diabetic, keep in mind for xmas
Divya update - hip op went ok, her mum home Sat. Divya v relieved. drop round some food early next wk
Isaac - Dr Morris at the practice said knee needs a scan. booked for 27 Nov 8.40am. he's annoyed abt missing 5 a side

Yusuf - quitting uni?? said the course isn't for him, 2nd yr engineering. applying for apprenticeships at BT + Network Rail instead, deadlines end of Jan 2027. his dad doesn't know yet, Farah does. Yusuf nervous abt the online tests. offered to help w/ his applications - should follow up next wk and send him the practice test links
Agnieszka's daughter - piano exam grade 5 on Sat. A says she's practising every night. ask how it went
interview prep for myself - Weds 10am video call w/ the Sainsbury's people. iron shirt, test webcam tues night
Siddharth's wife Zoe pregnant!! due April 2027. he told me at lunch, they're telling family this wknd
Efua - loves dark choc + rooibos. can't do caffeine after 2pm. ok for a xmas hamper idea
Arturo's restaurant job interview Thurs - sous chef role @ a place in Hackney. trial shift Sat lunchtime if it goes ok

Farah's dad - prostate op 9 Dec, morning. Farah flying back from Bristol the night before, staying 2 wks. Yusuf handling the hospital stuff + driving. she's worried, he's 68 and has a heart thing. their mum died 2019 so it's all on them. call Farah after the op, maybe the 10th. also send her the M&S voucher thing for meals
Heather - lives in Harrogate, 2 cats. sister Aoife lives near me in Brixton
Obi heard back - didn't get the civil service job. applying for another 3 next month. seems ok abt it actually
Bethany - kid's nut allergy (peanut + cashew). no nutty stuff at the party

Oliver took the job!! back @ the agency w/ Mrs Bianchi from 5 Jan 2027, senior designer this time + more money. leaving do at current place Fri 19 Dec from 6pm, the pub by Old St. his partner Heather's organising a card - must chip in, she said a tenner. he's v excited, said it feels like going home
Marcus - doesn't like curry?? still can't believe it. likes Thai though
Yuki got the Kew job!!! starts Feb 2027. remind me to send flowers + a card
Elif's brother Sam - lives Istanbul, flying in 4 Dec for 2 wks. she wants to do a dinner Fri 5th, 8pm
Victor's interview @ Monzo next Tues 11am - much keener on this one than Google. text him good luck mon night

Ibrahim - 70th bday Sun 30 Nov. Idris throwing him a lunch at the Turkish place on the high st, 1pm, abt 20 people. I said I'd bring a cake - he likes lemon drizzle not choc, diabetic-ish so maybe a small one. gift: he mentioned his radio broke, a DAB one wd go down well. ask Idris if anyone's already getting that
Kofi - new job as head of data @ the council. moved to Lewisham last month w/ Zoe + kids. Zoe still works at the school

Demi said her driving test got cancelled this morning - examiner off sick, she'd taken the day off work for it. 4th attempt too. rebooked for 15 Jan 2027 at 9.15. she was close to tears. remind me to text her tonight + offer a practice drive over xmas in my car
Camila took the NHS job in the end - starts Mon 1 Dec. ask her how the first week went, maybe Fri
Abebe & Efua - celebrating 10th anniversary in Lisbon, flying 2 Nov, back 9th. their dog Teddy staying with me!
post office - return the parcel by Sat. cancel gym trial

Aoife's interview for the head teacher role - Tues 2 Dec at 1.30pm, then a presentation to the governors at 3. she's convinced she won't get it, third time applying + the deputy from the other school is going for it too. her husband thinks she's a shoo in. remind me to ring her Mon night, then again Tues evening after to see how it went
